Studied: Medicine.description:
🩺 You took medical or nursing coursework, worked as a clinic assistant or grew up helping in a family doctor's practice.

🌱 Anatomy, diagnosis, medications and doses, wound care. You can recognize shock or a concussion and assist a doctor.
⚠️ Surgery, rare conditions and Quirk-linked illness are beyond you.
⚖️ You are not a licensed doctor or nurse; treating patients on your own authority or prescribing is illegal.
🏫 It shows in clinical vocabulary and steady attention at a bedside.

📈 Grants: Medicine +15
Studied: Medicine.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied medicine: anatomy, common illnesses, diagnosis from symptoms, medications and doses, wound care and how hospitals run. They can explain an injury, recognize shock or a concussion and assist a doctor. Prior study, not mastery: surgery, rare conditions and Quirk-linked illness are beyond them. Not a license: they are not a licensed doctor or nurse; treating patients on their own authority or prescribing is illegal. It shows in clinical vocabulary and steady attention at a bedside.
